# What’s new in Kulula 0.9.0
- Get a system notification when a thread needs your input or finishes in the background. - Refresh pull request findings manually, and find closed pull requests under the History filter. - See Claude session limits and clearer usage warnings in Status. - Keep composer drafts when switching threads, navigate suggestions with the keyboard, and use slash action suggestions after model mentions. - Select inline transcript notes and read longer approval commands without truncation. - Continue thread work after a worktree moves or is lost.

# What’s new in Kulula 0.8.0
- Choose Claude or Codex, and a model, for local pull request reviews. - New subthreads inherit the selected engine and model. You can choose the branch where a subthread starts. - The sidebar shows the model last used in each thread, and you can switch models while continuing a provider conversation. - Composer suggestions make it quicker to enter supported commands and mentions. - Copy a completed turn from the transcript. Inline code is now easier to read. - Pull request review state is retained when you switch threads, and the app refreshes branch divergence after an engine turn. - Auto Fix reports its progress more clearly and handles interrupted Gemini output as a failed fix.

## Worktrees per branch
Threads now work in isolated Git worktrees, one per branch, rather than sharing your main working tree. Multiple engines can work on different tasks simultaneously without overwriting files or stepping on each other's changes.
• Subthreads spawned for new work get their own branch and worktree. • When a pull request is merged, its worktree is automatically cleaned up. • The review panel and review actions operate directly inside the pull request's worktree. • The disk space taken up by build products in linked worktrees is displayed.
## Pull and Git error handoff in the review panel
• **Pull**: A new Pull button appears when your local branch is behind its tracking upstream, letting you fast-forward safely before fixing or shipping. • **Resolve conflicts**: When a pull request conflicts with its target base branch, the panel offers a Resolve action to guide the agent in resolving the merge conflicts. • **Ask Agent**: Git errors (such as checkout contention or push rejections) offer an Ask Agent button to hand the exception directly to the thread's selected engine to diagnose and fix.
## Quieter reviews
Review findings strip out machine tracking comments and bot receipt tags added by automated review bots, keeping prompts and draft replies clean.
---
Requires macOS 26 with Apple Intelligence, and `claude`, `codex` and `agy` installed on your login PATH and logged in.
